g.text: Restaurant Rush | Turn 7: choose, price and prepare (sequence 3 of 4)
Regular index 3 is divisible by 3, so chooses the offered combo.
VIP would cycle; Critic would always choose Pasta.
Final billCents = 1944. Combo's 2430 price was computed
accepted; "C3 orders Salad + Pasta combo ($19.44) as O3"
Page 4: end turn 7, recovery/preparation, serving, eating and payment.
All legality checks precede nextOrderId(), so rejection cannot skip an ID.
Customer stores the order reference but never calls its methods.
Bill computation belongs to Order/Money, not the UI or customer.
Continues after page 2: the Waiter may order for a customer the Host seated this turn.
Constructor arrow abbreviates creation syntax; the complete price order is personal discount then Happy Hour, rounded per step.
